assumptions.text: News attention to a zone rises when something changes there, not only when the news cycle turns to it.

test.rule: Alarms checked against events: scripts/eval_rising.py (63 scored days, 26 Aug-27 Oct 2026) and the 12-26 Oct alarm review in CLAUDE.md

assumptions.note: Attention is noisier than violence: name matches (Ilhan Omar under Somalia), routine Finnish and Norwegian news, Vietnamese weather headlines naming Bien Dong.

assumptions.text: A headline that names the zone means the story is about the zone.

test.rule: catalog/eval/relevance_v1.jsonl (278 stories): headline terms 82% precision, 78% retention

assumptions.note: Likely flattered: the same reviewer wrote the terms and the labels. Gemini's relevance call agreed with the labels on 243 of 253.

assumptions.text: GDELT places violent events in the right country.

test.rule: Spot checks of violent.jsonl on the map; known misplacements recorded in CLAUDE.md

assumptions.note: GDELT geocodes names: 'Guadalupe' became Guadeloupe. Country-level counts only; never read a single event's place as fact.

assumptions.text: The previous 28 days describe normal for a zone.

test.rule: Every score carries the 90-day median beside the 28-day z; WF-IND-3 flags weeks-long rises the 28-day z absorbs

assumptions.note: On 27 Oct 2026 Ethiopia's violence read normal against 28 days while running 5.6x its 90-day median. JP 2-01.3 warns that a steady signal can come to look normal.

assumptions.text: Feeds that refuse Google Cloud addresses (France 24, RFI Afrique, Times of Israel, ReliefWeb, Suspilne) are still covered through GDELT by domain.

test.rule: Feed health in state; GDELT rows by domain for the same outlets

assumptions.note: Tested 31 Oct 2026 on the 29 and 30 Oct cycle files (~30,000 matched GDELT rows a day): france24.com 0, timesofisrael.com 0, reliefweb.int 0, suspilne.media 0, rfi.fr 2-3 a day, against jpost.com 95. GDELT does not carry these outlets either. Suspilne's feed works again from 31 Oct; the other four are read through Google News site: searches from catalog 2026-10-31.1.
